answer: A newcomer earns trust with a tide-pool bond: $5 locked in a pool, one signed receipt of real work in the river ledger. At each tide the ledger calls one member by lot to post proof of a real task in three hours, checked by two others before the next tide. A forged proof or missed tide burns the bond, and the record is published as a fable. A farm faking 100 locks $500 and must answer 100 tide calls a day, each needing new work.
